concerns.text: T103 is too coarse for deterministic execution: it bundles bulk reconstruction, cluster generation, GB supercell construction, impurity insertion, zero-impurity filtering, all of descriptors.py, and two unit-test files into one task. Split so the atomizer can act (e.g. separate gb_builder, descriptor computation, and test tasks).

T108 packs four distinct deliverables (linearity assessment, GroupKFold CV, held-out evaluation with permutation test and prediction intervals, power analysis) into one task — too coarse; each has its own verification and should be a separate task.

T111's deliverable is vague: 'Add edge-case and runtime checks to tests/unit/' names no test files or test function names, unlike T101–T110. Specify e.g. tests/unit/test_descriptors.py::test_collinearity_detection, a named missing-energy-exclusion test, and a named zero-impurity-filter test.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T108 item (3) 'permutation-test p-value for R² (N permutations per plan, pinned seed)'
concerns.text: The plan does not state the permutation count N anywhere (plan.md Phase 8 only says 'permutation testing for R² significance'), so 'N permutations per plan' is not self-contained — the implementer cannot determine the value. State the number (e.g. 1000) in the task or plan.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T102 'itertools.islice the first N=600 records across the Fe-Cr, Ni-Al, Cu-Zn composition families'
concerns.text: The sampling rule is ambiguous: is 600 total or 600 per family, and how are records assigned to families (by formula match?). An implementer cannot reproduce the same sample deterministically without this specified.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T103 vs plan.md Phase 3 / data-model.md ClusteringDescriptor
concerns.text: T103 instructs descriptors 'from the pre-insertion cluster geometry' while plan.md Phase 3 and data-model.md mandate 'after EAM relaxation, only within the interface mask'. The implementer receives contradictory instructions for the same code path; reconcile plan/data-model with the tasks' corrected methodology (or vice versa) before execution.

T104 bundles potential download, leave-one-out energy computation, dataset assembly, schema validation, and sample-size justification into one task — coarse; consider splitting energy simulation from training-set assembly (which depends on T103 outputs).
